data.one_liner: A forward-only event-based package for parsing large JSON files and objects in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Processes large JSON files in a forward-only way and emits events based on encountered tokens. Provides mixins like JsonObjectTraverser and JsonArrayTraverser to easily parse streams into typed objects.
use_when: You need to parse very large JSON files that would consume too much memory if loaded all at once.
You are processing JSON from a Stream or String in a forward-only event-driven manner.
avoid_when: You need simple static JSON serialization with code generation (use built_value or freezed).
You are working on the web and need to handle very large numbers that exceed JavaScript number compatibility.
strengths: Memory efficient for large JSON structures through stream transformation and forward-only processing.
Provides mixins for clean custom object and array parsing.
weaknesses: Web platform has limitations with very big numbers due to JavaScript compatibility.
Manual setup of traversal logic is required compared to automated code-generation libraries.
